Carry out safe work practices and instructions in an ICT environment

performance_criteria.description: Identify work environment hazards in an ICT environment
State various methods to reduce the risk of identified hazards in an ICT environment
Demonstrate use of safety equipment applicable to ICT environment.

performance_criteria.description: State how to maintain hygienic, safe and secure workplace.
Demonstrate the uses of safety equipment in an ICT environment as required.
Identify basic first aid equipment
Illustrate basic first aid treatments

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate safe work habit and clean work environment

performance_criteria.description: Use safe access and exit routes in the work environment
Dispose all wastes appropriately to designated waste facilities

learning_outcomes.description: Know of the importance of good communication

performance_criteria.description: State reasons why good communication is important
List ways to communicate effectively
Exhibit patience and a mild demeanor while communicating with colleagues, managers and clients
Demonstrate how to speak in a respectful manner
Use respectful body language even when in a bad mood or while under pressure

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate ability to follow documented instructions

performance_criteria.description: Read and accurately follow steps in a web framework/plugins installation manual
Find specific Class definitions and Method descriptions in the programming language reference document.
Find feature descriptions in the plugin framework documentation, while using a plugins/framework,

learning_outcomes.description: Positive working relationship with colleagues

performance_criteria.description: Identify the need for developing positive working relationship with colleagues
Recognize the importance of relating with other people in a way that makes them feel valued and respected
Assist team members when required.
Report to the appropriate personnel when request for assistance fall outside area of responsibility.
Communicate information to colleagues about individual work that may affect team work.

learning_outcomes.description: Take responsibility within the team

performance_criteria.description: Recognize own role and responsibilities within a team
Perform individual tasks in line with the team’s rules and regulations.
Participate effectively in teamwork.

Work in line with organizational standard
Use organizational code of practice
Adhere strictly to instructions given by the Management

learning_outcomes.description: Develop complex database-driven applications using PHP and MySQL

performance_criteria.description: Design normalized, scalable database schemas to handle large product catalogs.
Develop complex queries to manage customer orders, inventory, and payments.
Integrate relational databases with PHP to facilitate seamless data retrieval.
Implement indexing and caching techniques to improve database performance.

learning_outcomes.description: Integrate third-party APIs for payment processing, shipping, and inventory management

performance_criteria.description: Implement payment gateway APIs such as PayPal, Stripe, Paystack, Flutter, etc.
Integrate shipping services to calculate real-time rates and track orders.
Synchronize external inventory management systems with the e-commerce platform.
Handle API errors and exceptions to ensure reliable data exchange.

learning_outcomes.description: Implement advanced security measures to protect e-commerce platforms

performance_criteria.description: Use encryption to secure sensitive customer information like payment data.
Develop secure login and authentication systems to prevent unauthorized access.
Implement secure session management to prevent session hijacking and XSS attacks.
Apply input sanitization and SQL injection protection to safeguard the platform.

units.title: ADVANCED E-COMMERCE DEVELOPMENT USING CONTENT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (CMS)

learning_outcomes.description: Develop custom Content Management System plugins for e-commerce functionality

performance_criteria.description: Write custom WooCommerce plugins to extend the functionality of online stores.
Use CMS hooks, filters, and short codes to modify plugin behaviour.
Ensure compatibility with existing CMS and WooCommerce core updates.
Test and debug plugins for security, performance, and functionality issues.

learning_outcomes.description: Customize Content Management System themes for enhanced e-commerce user experience

performance_criteria.description: Modify theme files to match brand identity and create a consistent user interface.
Use responsive design techniques to ensure compatibility across all devices.
Integrate custom product display features, such as product sliders and grids.
Optimize themes for SEO, fast loading times, and usability.

learning_outcomes.description: Scale Content Management System e-commerce sites for high traffic and large product catalogs

performance_criteria.description: Implement caching solutions like WP Super Cache and W3 Total Cache to speed up sites
Set up Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) to improve performance for global users.
Optimize MySQL databases for fast data retrieval in high-traffic environments.
Monitor server performance and optimize hosting environments to manage large product volumes.

learning_outcomes.description: Design database schemas for e-commerce platforms.

performance_criteria.description: Create normalized database structures to support large product catalogs.
Design efficient product, customer, and order management systems.
Implement relational and non-relational databases for scalable solutions.
Use foreign keys, indexing, and relationships to optimize data access.

learning_outcomes.description: Optimize database performance for high-traffic e-commerce platforms.

performance_criteria.description: Implement indexing and query optimization techniques.
Use database caching to reduce load times.
Troubleshoot database performance issues.
Scale databases to handle growth and increased transactions.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure database security and integrity.

performance_criteria.description: Implement secure data storage methods, including encryption for sensitive data.
Set up backup and disaster recovery plans.
Analyze databases for security vulnerabilities and unauthorized access.
Enforce database access controls and audit trails.

learning_outcomes.description: Integrate databases with external systems for reporting and analytics.

performance_criteria.description: Export data from databases to external systems for analytics.
Import data from databases to external systems for analytics.
Use APIs to connect databases with third-party systems such as CRMs.
Set up real-time data sync with inventory management or order fulfillment systems.
Ensure data integrity across different systems.

learning_outcomes.description: Analyze e-commerce data to understand consumer behaviour

performance_criteria.description: Collect and organize data from various sources (e.g., Google Analytics, CRM systems) to understand key user interactions
Perform customer segmentation based on purchasing history, demographics, and website behaviour
Use data visualization tools to identify patterns and trends in consumer purchasing behaviour.
Analyse bounce rates, cart abandonment rates, and time spent on product pages to understand customer decision-making.

learning_outcomes.description: Optimize conversion rates based on data insights.

performance_criteria.description: Identify bottlenecks in the checkout process by analyzing funnel drop-off points
A/B test different versions of landing pages, product pages, and calls-to-action (CTAs) to improve user engagement
Implement dynamic pricing strategies or personalized recommendations based on data insights
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as conversion rate, average order value, and customer lifetime value to measure optimization efforts

learning_outcomes.description: Implement data-driven marketing campaigns for e-commerce growth.

performance_criteria.description: Analyse customer data to create targeted email marketing campaigns for specific consumer segments
Use website traffic and purchase history data to implement retargeting campaigns via Google Ads, Facebook, and other platforms
Create personalized marketing content (e.g., product recommendations) based on customer browsing and purchase data.
Monitor the performance of marketing campaigns in real-time and adjust strategies based on data-driven insights to improve ROI.

learning_outcomes.description: Implement Encryption and Secure Communication Protocols

performance_criteria.description: Apply SSL/TLS certificates to secure communications between the server and client.
Use encryption standards like AES and RSA to protect sensitive data at rest and during transmission.
Implement HTTPS protocols across all e-commerce site pages, ensuring secure data exchanges.
Regularly update encryption protocols to mitigate vulnerabilities.

learning_outcomes.description: Protect Against Common Web Vulnerabilities (SQL Injection, XSS, etc.)

performance_criteria.description: Apply input validation and sanitization to prevent SQL injection attacks.
Use secure coding practices to mitigate cross-site scripting (XSS) and cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerabilities.
Conduct regular security audits and penetration testing to identify and fix vulnerabilities.
Monitor website activity logs for signs of attacks and implement real-time alerts.

learning_outcomes.description: Implement User Authentication and Access Controls

performance_criteria.description: Set up multi-factor authentication (MFA) for user logins, especially for admin accounts.
Use role-based access controls (RBAC) to limit permissions to sensitive areas of the platform.
Encrypt passwords using hashing algorithms like bcrypt or Argon2 before storing them in the database.
Implement secure password recovery systems that prevent unauthorized account access.

learning_outcomes.description: Monitor system against Security Threats

performance_criteria.description: Use real-time monitoring tools like Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) to detect unauthorized access.
Implement automated alerts to notify the security team of suspicious activities on the platform.
Set up firewalls to block unauthorized traffic and mitigate Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks.
Develop an incident response plan to effectively address and mitigate data breaches or cyber-attacks.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand Data Privacy Regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)

performance_criteria.description: Identify key regulations and requirements of GDPR, CCPA, and other relevant data protection laws.
Implement data processing activities that ensure compliance with the consent, right to access, and data deletion requests.
Maintain an updated data protection policy that clearly outlines how customer data is collected, processed, and protected.
Conduct data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) to ensure data processing activities align with legal requirements and do not infringe on user privacy.

learning_outcomes.description: Implement Secure Data Storage and Management Techniques

performance_criteria.description: Use encryption methods (e.g., AES, RSA) to securely store sensitive user data such as payment information, addresses, and personal identifiers.
Implement secure access controls, ensuring only authorized personnel have access to customer data.
Regularly audit and monitor database logs to detect and prevent unauthorized access or data breaches.
Develop secure data backup and disaster recovery plans to protect data integrity in case of hardware or software failures.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure Data Security during Transactions

performance_criteria.description: Use Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) certificates to encrypt data during transmission between customers and the e-commerce platform.
Implement tokenization for payment card data, replacing sensitive information with unique tokens that can be securely stored.
Regularly update security protocols, such as Transport Layer Security (TLS), to protect against man-in-the-middle attacks and data interception.
Conduct regular penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in transaction security and fix potential risks.

learning_outcomes.description: Create User-Friendly Data Privacy Controls

performance_criteria.description: Develop a user-friendly privacy dashboard where customers can manage their data consent preferences and access their data.
Provide clear and transparent information about data collection, use, and storage, making it easy for customers to understand their rights.
Implement easy-to-use mechanisms for customers to request data deletion, data correction, or download their personal information.
Track and record customer consent for data processing activities, ensuring compliance with legal obligations and facilitating accountability.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure Compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and Other Data Privacy Regulations

performance_criteria.description: Implement clear user consent mechanisms for data collection, processing, and sharing in compliance with GDPR and CCPA.
Develop privacy policies that are compliant with regional and international data privacy laws.
Ensure that users have the ability to access, modify, and delete their personal data as per regulatory requirements.
Regularly audit data handling processes to ensure ongoing compliance with legal requirements.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure Compliance with Payment Industry Standards (PCI DSS)

performance_criteria.description: Use PCI-compliant payment gateways and tokenization methods to secure credit card transactions.
Implement encryption for all cardholder data to ensure secure transactions.
Conduct regular vulnerability scans and penetration tests to maintain PCI DSS compliance.
Ensure that sensitive data such as card numbers are not stored unless absolutely necessary and, if stored, are encrypted.

learning_outcomes.description: Ensure Compliance with Regional E-Commerce Regulations

performance_criteria.description: Implement VAT, sales tax, and other legal requirements based on the region of operation.
Ensure compliance with export control laws when conducting cross-border e-commerce transactions.
Adhere to region-specific consumer protection laws, ensuring transparent product descriptions and terms of service.
Regularly review and update terms and conditions, refund policies, and dispute resolution mechanisms to ensure they meet regional legal standards.

learning_outcomes.description: Maintain Accurate Records and Documentation for Compliance Audits

performance_criteria.description: Keep detailed logs of all transactions, including payment processing, user interactions, and order fulfilment.
Maintain proper documentation of all security measures and compliance activities for audits.
Ensure that data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) are regularly updated and archived.
Implement version control for legal documents, contracts, and terms of service to track changes and ensure auditability.

learning_outcomes.description: Implement a multi-channel e-commerce strategy

performance_criteria.description: Identify suitable sales channels for a business based on target audience and product type.
Develop an e-commerce strategy for multiple platforms, including websites, marketplaces, and social media.
Configure platform-specific tools such as product listings, payment options, and shipping settings.
Evaluate the performance of sales channels using analytics to improve sales and engagement.

learning_outcomes.description: Develop user-centric designs for mobile e-commerce platforms

performance_criteria.description: Create mobile-friendly layouts that ensure seamless user experiences across devices.
Optimize e-commerce features, including search, navigation, and checkout, for mobile users.
Implement mobile-specific functionalities like push notifications and mobile payments.
Conduct usability testing to identify issues that hinder mobile user satisfaction.

learning_outcomes.description: Integrate and manage inventory and customer data across multiple sales channels

performance_criteria.description: Implement an inventory management system to synchronize stock levels across all sales channels.
Set up a centralized system to track and manage customer data across platforms.
Automate workflows to update order statuses and manage returns from various channels.
Ensure compliance with regulations when managing customer and inventory data.
